SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, o.student_id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, s.phone, o.type, o.content, o.receivable, o.received, o.discount, o.debt, h.name AS handlerName, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.status, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.remark FROM sales_order o JOIN student s ON s.id = o.student_id JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = o.campus_id LEFT JOIN staff h ON h.id = o.handler_id
ORDER BY o.paid_at DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(o.receivable), 0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(o.received), 0) AS received, COALESCE(SUM(o.discount), 0) AS discount, COALESCE(SUM(o.debt), 0) AS debt FROM sales_order o JOIN student s ON s.id = o.student_id
